g.text: Why one bar: whisper-tiny's decoder uses the same matrix to read a token in (embed_tokens)
and to score it as the next output (proj_out). Scaling one row therefore changes both
that token's input embedding and its output logit.
- 426 digit-token rows x 0.65 (fewer digits, more spelled-out numbers)

g.text: Where the registered edits sit. All 165,888 changed weights (0.44% of the model) are rows of the decoder's token-embedding matrix, which shares
storage with the output projection; the encoder, attention and feed-forward weights are untouched.
Bars labelled 0 have no changed weights: encoder, attention, feed-forward, positional and layer-norm weights are bit-identical to the base model. The tied matrix is counted
